parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing exposure is documented mainly through police targeting of visibly trans people: extortion-driven violence (twelve injured after a refusal, twelve hijras arrested), arrests of five trans women at the international airport, and a 2017 raid in which about 120 people were beaten and 28 arrested. A trans advocate was murdered in 2025, and a national monitor records a rising trend of violations since 2022, though it covers LGBTQI+ people broadly with no denominator. Post-2024 Islamist mobilisation and reports of trans people in hiding suggest worsening conditions. Section 377 is rarely enforced but used for harassment. Third-gender recognition and a 2015 medical-verification memo are resident-facing and weighted as climate only. The dossier has no border or document data, so that axis is open. Remedies are thin, leading to a high-risk placement.
